dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple distinct 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored perimeters are visible on the mid-lateral flank. These exhibit sharp high-contrast transitions from a light-gray outer ring to a darker interior, with edge widths approximately 2-5 pixels at this resolution.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid high-intensity light-gray pixel clusters without internal gradients, primarily situated in the interstitial spaces between larger annuli in the posterior and central regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent annuli in the central flank form an obtuse scalene triangle. A group of smaller blobs towards the posterior forms a roughly linear arrangement of four keypoints.

other_distinctive_markers: A series of interconnected, high-contrast undulating light lines forming a complex network pattern along the upper mid-section, distinct from the discrete circular annuli.
